section_summary: Pages 154–175 finish the November 1946 issue of the Bank of Japan’s Financial Statistics Monthly, with tables on banking, insurance, savings, securities, prices, bonds, and capital. Pages 176–191 begin the January 1947 issue, including its cover, contents, graph, and financial tables. The section is statistical rather than correspondence.

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, November 1946, concluding pages
subfiles.about: The concluding tables of the November 1946 issue report Japanese financial institutions, markets, prices, public debt, and capital.
subfiles.summary: The tables cover banks, trust and insurance companies, credit cooperatives, postal savings, the Deposit Bureau, and the stock exchange. They also report Tokyo prices, government bond issues, short term securities, corporate debentures, and planned and paid capital. Page 175 gives the publication imprint, dated November 25, 1946.

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, January 1947, opening pages
subfiles.about: The opening pages of the January 1947 issue present its contents, financial graph, and initial banking tables.
subfiles.summary: The issue opens with a cover, Japanese and English contents, and a graph of bank deposits, loans, and Bank of Japan note issues and loans. Subsequent tables give the Bank of Japan’s ten day returns and comparative figures for financial institutions, including deposits, lending, and securities holdings. The excerpt ends during the ordinary banks table.
